heading: Binding Effect; Governing Law, Venue, and Jurisdiction
memo_rationale: Covered Virginia contracts cannot mandate New York or Florida litigation. New York’s $250,000 choice-of-law safe harbor is not the only route to enforcement; below it the choice is not automatically invalid, but the relevant relationship/conflicts analysis remains, especially for a Florida buyer. The forum safe harbor has a separate $1 million threshold. Contractual choice also cannot displace mandatory Article 9 perfection rules. The proposed merchant-state venue is a conservative national-form solution. [A6, A7, A11]
memo_replacement: This Agreement binds the parties and their permitted successors and assigns under Section 7.2. Subject to mandatory federal law and applicable conflict-of-laws rules, the substantive law of the state of Merchant’s principal place of business identified in Section 1 governs this Agreement. Any action arising under this Agreement shall be brought in a state court of competent jurisdiction in that state or a federal court of competent jurisdiction located there. For a transaction subject to Virginia Code Section 6.2-2234, any action shall be brought in the Commonwealth of Virginia. Nothing selects a court lacking subject-matter jurisdiction, waives valid service, or overrides a mandatory venue or non-waivable statutory protection. Perfection, priority, and the effect of perfection or nonperfection are governed by the mandatory rules of applicable Article 9. Judicial process is governed by Section 10.1.
current_body: This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors and assigns, except that Merchant shall not have the right to assign its rights hereunder or any interest herein without the prior written consent of Buyer, which consent may be withheld in Buyer’s sole discretion. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York. This Agreement is for the sale of Merchant’s future Receipts and is subject to the Uniform Commercial Code as adopted in New York. Any suit, action, or proceeding arising hereunder, or the interpretation, performance, or breach hereof, shall, if Buyer so elects, be instituted in any court sitting in New York State or in Pasco County, Florida (the “Acceptable Forums”). The parties agree that the Acceptable Forums are convenient and submit to the jurisdiction of the Acceptable Forums and waive any and all objections to jurisdiction or venue. Should a proceeding be initiated in any other forum, the parties waive any right to oppose any motion or application made by either party to transfer such proceeding to an Acceptable Forum. Merchant and Guarantor(s) further agree that mailing by certified or registered mail, return receipt requested, of any process required by any such court will constitute valid and lawful service of process against them, without the necessity for service by any other means.
my_note: Covered Virginia transactions must be litigated in Virginia — a New York or Florida forum clause is void as to them, full stop. Merchant-state venue is the conservative national answer and I agree with it for a multi-state form. Note the memo's point that GOL §5-1401 and §5-1402 have different thresholds ($250k / $1m); do not conflate them.

heading: Severability
memo_rationale: The unconditional remainder-survives rule cannot override statutes making an entire contract void. Qualify it and remove prohibited clauses before execution; severability is not a substitute for a compliant form. [A10–A12]
memo_replacement: If a provision is held invalid or unenforceable, it may be severed only to the extent applicable law permits and only if doing so does not defeat the essential lawful bargain. No severability or savings language preserves this Agreement when applicable law makes the entire contract void, and no provision is rewritten to permit a prohibited charge, waiver, or collection practice. Buyer shall omit prohibited terms from the form before presenting it for signature.
current_body: In case any of the provisions in this Agreement is found to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable in any respect, the validity, legality, and enforceability of any other provision contained herein shall not in any way be affected or impaired. Any provision hereof prohibited by law shall be ineffective only to the extent of such prohibition without invalidating the remaining provisions hereof.
my_note: Rated High; treat as a blocker. Texas §398.055 voids the whole contract containing a confession of judgment or similar provision, and no severability clause can override a statute that voids. The answer is to not ship the provision into Texas, which is what the §7.24 rider is for.

heading: Jury Trial Waiver
memo_rationale: The extensive-attorney-consultation recital contradicts §§7.22/9.6 and may be factually false. Predispute jury waivers also vary by forum; California state courts do not enforce a contractual predispute jury waiver absent statutory authorization. The national-form recommendation is deletion, preserving all rights; a narrower jurisdiction-specific waiver would require separate analysis. [A20]
memo_replacement: Each party retains any right to trial by jury available under applicable law. No party represents that it consulted an attorney unless it actually did so.
current_body: THE PARTIES HERETO WAIVE TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY COURT IN ANY SUIT, ACTION, OR PROCEEDING ON ANY MATTER ARISING IN CONNECTION WITH OR IN ANY WAY RELATED TO THE TRANSACTIONS OF WHICH THIS AGREEMENT IS A PART OR THE ENFORCEMENT HEREOF. THE PARTIES HERETO ACKNOWLEDGE THAT EACH MAKES THIS WAIVER KNOWINGLY, WILLINGLY, AND VOLUNTARILY AND WITHOUT DURESS, AND ONLY AFTER EXTENSIVE CONSIDERATION OF THE RAMIFICATIONS OF THIS WAIVER WITH THEIR ATTORNEYS.
my_note: Do not delete from the national form. Grafton makes a predispute jury waiver unenforceable in California state court; it does not make it unenforceable in Florida, New York or Texas. We already have a rider mechanism at §7.24 built for exactly this. Adopt instead: a jury waiver conditioned on the rider, disabled where unenforceable. Do delete the false 'extensive attorney consultation' recital, which contradicts §§7.22/9.6 and may simply be untrue.

heading: Class Action Waiver
memo_rationale: The existing statutory/public-policy carveout is meaningful; the clause is not categorically unlawful. A standalone class waiver without an arbitration structure has forum-dependent enforceability and adds litigation friction. The proposed balanced national form removes it; this is a commercial risk recommendation.
memo_replacement: No party waives any right to bring, defend, or participate in a class, collective, representative, or public-enforcement proceeding that applicable law permits. The availability and form of any proceeding shall be determined by the court under applicable law.
current_body: THE PARTIES HERETO WAIVE ANY RIGHT TO ASSERT ANY CLAIMS AGAINST THE OTHER PARTY, AS A REPRESENTATIVE OR MEMBER IN ANY CLASS OR REPRESENTATIVE ACTION, EXCEPT WHERE SUCH WAIVER IS PROHIBITED BY LAW OR AGAINST PUBLIC POLICY.
my_note: Do not decide this clause in isolation. The memo removes a standalone class waiver on the correct ground that it is forum-dependent without an arbitration structure — and then never asks whether this should be an arbitration product. For a small-dollar B2B product across eleven states that is a first-order structural choice with real cost consequences. Park 067 until that is decided.

heading: Service of Process
memo_rationale: Service deemed complete when mail is undeliverable can yield a default judgment without notice. Some consensual service mechanisms are enforceable; email service is not automatically a confession of judgment. Nevertheless, broad service and objection waivers should be removed from this national form, including the duplicate Section 10 provisions. [A10–A12, A21]
memo_replacement: Service of summons, complaint, and other judicial process is governed exclusively by Section 10.1. An operational notice, unacknowledged email, or returned or undeliverable mailing does not by this Agreement establish valid service or waive any objection to it. Response deadlines are those established by applicable procedural law or court order.
current_body: IN ADDITION TO THE METHODS OF SERVICE ALLOWED BY STATE LAW, MERCHANT HEREBY CONSENTS TO SERVICE OF PROCESS UPON IT BY REGISTERED OR CERTIFIED MAIL, RETURN RECEIPT REQUESTED. SERVICE HEREUNDER SHALL BE COMPLETE UPON MERCHANT’S ACTUAL RECEIPT OF PROCESS OR UPON BUYER’S RECEIPT OF THE RETURN THEREOF BY THE UNITED STATES POSTAL SERVICE AS REFUSED OR UNDELIVERABLE. MERCHANT MUST PROMPTLY NOTIFY BUYER, IN WRITING, OF EACH AND EVERY CHANGE OF ADDRESS TO WHICH SERVICE OF PROCESS CAN BE MADE. SERVICE BY BUYER TO THE LAST KNOWN ADDRESS SHALL BE SUFFICIENT. MERCHANT WILL HAVE THIRTY (30) CALENDAR DAYS AFTER SERVICE HEREUNDER IS COMPLETE IN WHICH TO RESPOND. THE PARTIES FURTHER AGREE TO ACCEPT SERVICE OF PROCESS BY EMAIL TO ANY EMAILS DESIGNATED IN THIS AGREEMENT.
my_note: Adopt the deletion of the service and objection waivers — service deemed complete when mail is undeliverable is how a default judgment gets entered against someone who never knew. Sixth REFUTATION: contractual email service is NOT automatically a confession of judgment, and our register says it is. Correct that, then delete the clause anyway on the narrower ground.

heading: Contractual Statutes of Limitations
memo_rationale: Reasonable contractual limitations can be enforceable in some settings; this one-sided one-year period covers every kind of claim and may conflict with non-waivable statutory rights. Remove it from a national small-business form.
memo_replacement: The limitation periods, accrual rules, tolling rules, and remedies supplied by applicable law apply to claims by every party. This Agreement does not shorten them.
current_body: Each Merchant and Guarantor agrees that any claim, whether sounding in contract, tort, law, equity, or otherwise, that is not asserted against Buyer within one (1) year after its accrual will be time-barred and forever waived, except to the extent such limitation is prohibited by applicable law.
my_note: Do not simply delete. A one-sided one-year period covering every claim type is indefensible; a mutual two-year period is ordinarily enforceable and worth keeping. Redraft rather than remove, and carve out non-waivable statutory claims.

heading: Counterclaim Waiver
memo_rationale: The draft does preserve transaction-related counterclaims, so it is not a total counterclaim bar. Requiring other claims to be brought separately adds avoidable cost and can obscure available defenses. The recommendation is to let procedural law govern.
memo_replacement: Each party may assert defenses, setoff, recoupment, and counterclaims to the extent permitted by applicable law and the procedural rules of the court. No separate action is required solely by this Agreement.
current_body: In any litigation commenced by Buyer to enforce this Agreement, the Guaranty, or any related agreement, no Merchant or Guarantor will be permitted to interpose any counterclaim, except for any counterclaim arising out of the same transaction or occurrence as Buyer’s claim, which Merchant and Guarantor may assert in that proceeding. Any non-compulsory counterclaim must be brought as a separate proceeding.
my_note: Agree. The clause already preserves same-transaction counterclaims, so it is not the bar our register implies; forcing everything else into a separate proceeding just adds cost. Let procedural law govern.

memo_rationale: Consolidate all judicial service provisions here. The objection waiver for absence of formal service is especially problematic. Preserve lawful service, jurisdiction, response periods, and prejudgment process rather than attempting to bypass them by contract. [A10–A12, A21]
memo_replacement: A summons, complaint, or other judicial process must be served on Merchant, Buyer, or a Guarantor in a manner authorized by the procedural law of the court and any applicable court order. No party prospectively waives valid service, an available jurisdictional objection, a legally required notice or hearing, or a required prior court order for a prejudgment remedy. This Agreement contains no confession of judgment or authorization to obtain judgment without lawful process. Operational notice methods do not establish service of process. Nothing prevents a separate voluntary waiver of service made after a proceeding begins in the manner then permitted by law.
current_body: Merchant hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives personal service of any summons, complaint, or other process, which may be made by any other means permitted by New York or Florida law. Merchant further agrees to waive any objection to the absence of formal service of process.
my_note: Critical. The waiver of objection for absence of formal service is the most dangerous sentence in Section 10. Consolidate all judicial service here and preserve lawful service, response periods and prejudgment process.

memo_rationale: Delete the freestanding advance email/postal consent and use §10.1. This does not assert that every consensual email service arrangement is invalid.
current_body: MERCHANT HEREBY AGREES TO ACCEPT SERVICE OF ANY SUMMONS, COMPLAINT, OR OTHER PROCESS BY ELECTRONIC MAIL AT _____________«48»_____________ OR BY UNITED STATES POSTAL SERVICE AT ____________________________«49»____________________________ OR BY ANY OTHER MEANS PERMITTED BY NEW YORK OR FLORIDA LAW.
my_note: Delete the freestanding advance email consent and route through §10.1. Note this does not assert that every consensual email-service arrangement is invalid — see 068.

memo_rationale: Current contacts remain useful, but a stale address cannot conclusively establish lawful judicial service.
memo_replacement: Each party and Guarantor shall promptly update its operational notice contacts under Sections 7.3 and 9.1. Failure to update does not by itself establish valid service of judicial process or waive a procedural protection.
current_body: Merchant or Guarantor shall notify Buyer of any changes to its physical address or email address for service. Unless Buyer is notified of a change in address, all addresses shall be presumed to be accurate.
my_note: Keep current-contact duties; drop the presumption that a stale address conclusively establishes lawful judicial service.

memo_rationale: Use an explicit distinction between ordinary communications and judicial process after consolidation.
memo_replacement: Section 10.1 exclusively governs judicial process. Section 7.3 governs ordinary contractual notices. Neither provision displaces mandatory procedural law or a court order.
current_body: This Section shall supersede any notice requirements in this Agreement with respect to service of process.
